dish: jingisukan with Sapporo draught beer (Kessel Hall all-you-can-eat)
n: Sapporo Beer Garden (サッポロビール園)
address: Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (beside the Sapporo Beer Museum)
w: Restaurants spread through the garden serve fresh-lamb jingisukan and seasonal Hokkaido produce with Sapporo draught — Kessel Hall does all-you-can-eat-and-drink.

n: Ganso Sapporo Ramen Yokochō (元祖さっぽろラーメン横丁)
w: The narrow Susukino alley of a dozen-plus tiny ramen counters, open into the small hours — the classic post-drinking miso bowl.

dish: chiffon cake set with Hokkaido-milk soft-serve
n: Kitakaro Sapporo Honkan (北菓楼 札幌本館)
address: Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (3 min walk from Ōdōri Park)
w: Kitakaro's flagship in a historic building long loved as the city library and an art museum — sweets shop plus a café serving the cake set with Hokkaido-milk soft-serve.
